verdict.rationale: Svelte documents `.svelte.js`/`.svelte.ts` modules that behave like ordinary JS/TS modules but can use runes. It also documents `$state` in class fields. Together these let reactive state and derived logic live outside components, which implies they can be exercised without rendering. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents unit testing that logic. A community comment notes the lack of a clear unit-testing solution or docs, though it is dated and not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: first-party unit-testing guidance or tooling, documented testing of runes/effects outside a component context, hands-on corroboration of DOM-free tests.
